# Threat register and authorization test matrix

Narrative: [../14-threat-model.md](../14-threat-model.md).

## Threats

| Threat | Category | Description | Mitigated by | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-01 | cross_workspace | ID substitution: a request names a record, brand, or project ID from another workspace. | I-02, I-03, I-07 | AT-001, AT-002, AT-003 |
| T-02 | cross_workspace | Background job or webhook processed under the wrong workspace context. | I-02, I-03 | AT-004 |
| T-03 | cross_brand_traversal | Read a hidden record through its parent, child, or breadcrumb. | I-05, I-07 | AT-005, AT-006, AT-079 |
| T-04 | cross_brand_traversal | Discover a hidden record through a dependency, related link, or derived Blocked condition. | I-05, I-07 | AT-007, AT-008, AT-009 |
| T-05 | cross_brand_traversal | Read hidden content through mentions, activity, or notifications. | I-04, I-07, I-08 | AT-010, AT-011, AT-012 |
| T-06 | cross_brand_traversal | Fetch hidden files through attachment URLs, signed URLs, or file version IDs. | I-04, I-07 | AT-013, AT-014 |
| T-07 | cross_brand_traversal | Obtain hidden records through export, report delivery, or webhooks. | I-08, I-14 | AT-015, AT-016, AT-017 |
| T-08 | cross_brand_traversal | Retrieve hidden records through search, AI answers, citations, or recommendations. | I-07, I-08, I-14 | AT-018, AT-019, AT-020 |
| T-09 | inference | Infer hidden records from counts, facets, pagination totals, capacity, or metric totals. | I-07, I-08 | AT-021, AT-022, AT-023, AT-078 |
| T-10 | inference | Distinguish nonexistent from unauthorized by status code, error text, timing, or uniqueness errors. | I-07 | AT-024, AT-025 |
| T-11 | inference | Use filters or sorts on hidden fields or hidden relationships as an oracle. | I-07, I-18 | AT-026, AT-027 |
| T-12 | restricted_project | Brand member reads a restricted project's tasks through brand-level grants or brand-wide views. | I-05, I-07 | AT-028, AT-029, AT-030, AT-078 |
| T-13 | restricted_project | Owner/admin silently reads a sensitive brand without elevation. | I-17, I-10 | AT-031, AT-032 |
| T-14 | revocation | Continue access after share expiry or revocation (cached pages, SSE, notifications, search). | I-12 | AT-033, AT-034, AT-035 |
| T-15 | revocation | Use a revoked or expired token, session, or OAuth consent. | I-12 | AT-036, AT-037, AT-038 |
| T-16 | team_change | Gain access by being added to a team that holds grants the adder cannot grant; or keep access after removal from a team. | I-11, I-12 | AT-039, AT-040 |
| T-17 | field_leak | Read a hidden field through a calculated field, conflict response, audit history, export, notification, search snippet, or AI. | I-18, I-16 | AT-041, AT-042, AT-043, AT-044, AT-045 |
| T-18 | staleness | A queued job or long-running agent acts with permissions that were revoked after enqueue. | I-12, I-14 | AT-046, AT-047 |
| T-19 | staleness | A cached derived condition or projection serves a stale authorization decision. | I-04, I-12 | AT-048, AT-049 |
| T-20 | guest_escalation | Guest reshares, sees unshared children/parents, the member directory, or all-brands aggregates. | I-07, I-11 | AT-050, AT-051, AT-052, AT-053, AT-054, AT-079, AT-115, AT-116 |
| T-21 | guest_escalation | Guest reaches trash or archived content of formerly shared records. | I-07, I-12 | AT-055, AT-056 |
| T-22 | agent_scope | Agent reads or acts outside its run scope (prompt-injected scope expansion). | I-14 | AT-057, AT-058 |
| T-23 | agent_scope | Confused deputy: low-privilege user assigns a task to a powerful agent or automation to reach data they cannot read. | I-11, I-14 | AT-059, AT-060 |
| T-24 | agent_scope | Agent, automation, or AI approves its own output or performs gated actions without approval. | I-15 | AT-061, AT-062, AT-080 |
| T-25 | spoofing | Forged inbound webhook or replayed provider event creates or modifies records. | I-01, I-09 | AT-063, AT-064 |
| T-26 | spoofing | Integration writes outside its mapped brand/project scope or exfiltrates via outbound sync. | I-14 | AT-017, AT-065 |
| T-27 | support_misuse | Platform support reads tenant data without a valid support grant or impersonates a user. | I-03, I-17 | AT-066, AT-067 |
| T-28 | support_misuse | Workspace admin exports or views data outside their authority or without audit. | I-11, I-17 | AT-068 |
| T-29 | departure | Departed member retains access via sessions, personal tokens, OAuth clients, automations, or running agents. | I-10, I-12 | AT-069, AT-070 |
| T-30 | departure | Last owner removed or ownership transfer escalates a non-owner. | I-11, I-17 | AT-071, AT-072 |
| T-31 | rls_leak | Pooled connection reuses another tenant's context or runs without context. | I-02, I-03 | AT-073, AT-074 |
| T-32 | rls_leak | Worker or maintenance role bypasses RLS broadly. | I-02, I-03 | AT-075 |
| T-33 | inference | Not-found versus forbidden difference reveals that a readable record exists but an action is forbidden — acceptable only for readable records. | I-07 | AT-076 |
| T-34 | cross_brand_traversal | Client supplies a brand, role, plan, actor, or approval field to bypass checks. | I-09, I-13 | AT-003, AT-077 |
| T-35 | spoofing | Account takeover through account security: a stolen or unattended session, or a delegated credential, enrolls or disables a second factor or regenerates recovery codes. | I-01, I-09, I-14, I-17 | AT-081, AT-082, AT-083, AT-084, AT-085, AT-086 |
| T-36 | spoofing | Tenant-creation abuse: a delegated or non-human principal, an unverified or deleted account, a flood of requests, or a replayed request creates workspaces or gains tenant authority through creation, or a body claim names an existing workspace, role, or membership. | I-01, I-02, I-09, I-11, I-14, I-17 | AT-087, AT-088, AT-089, AT-090, AT-091, AT-092, AT-093, AT-094 |
| T-37 | spoofing | Invitation abuse: replaying, forwarding, or racing an invitation token; accepting with a different account; enumerating accounts or memberships through invite outcomes; a guest invitation conferring workspace, brand, or inherited access; an administrator inviting an owner. | I-01, I-04, I-07, I-09, I-11, I-17 | AT-095, AT-096, AT-097, AT-098, AT-099, AT-100, AT-101, AT-102 |
| T-38 | departure | Ownership or departure failure: a workspace left without an active owner, an ownership transfer accepted by the wrong principal or without step-up, a removed or suspended member keeping access through sessions, cached contexts, teams, grants, queued jobs, or pooled connections, or owned resources left without an accountable owner. | I-01, I-11, I-12, I-17 | AT-103, AT-104, AT-105, AT-106, AT-107 |
| T-39 | inference | Personal navigation leakage: favorites, recents, view state, URL scope, breadcrumbs, page titles, palette results, shortcuts, or navigation entries revealing or re-opening a record, brand, person, or destination the viewer can no longer (or never could) access, including through forged identifiers, stale client caches, stored state, or another workspace's identifiers. | I-01, I-02, I-11, I-12 | AT-108, AT-109, AT-110, AT-111, AT-112, AT-113, AT-114 |

## Response shapes

| Shape | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ok` | Full authorized response |
| `ok_filtered` | Authorized response with hidden elements omitted |
| `omitted` | Item absent; no placeholder, count, or hint |
| `not_found` | Indistinguishable not-found (same status, body shape, headers, and timing envelope as nonexistent) |
| `forbidden` | Known-limited permission on a readable resource (ST-42) |
| `unauthenticated` | Credential invalid; no resource information |
| `approval_required` | Action held pending approval |
| `suspended` | Principal suspended; nothing executed |
| `redacted` | Value replaced by redaction marker |
| `conflict_filtered` | Conflict response without unreadable current values |
| `validation_generic` | Generic validation error naming only the caller's own input |
| `empty` | Zero rows |
| `error_generic` | Generic error without tenant data |
| `step_up_required` | Fresh step-up proof required; nothing executed and no resource information beyond the challenge |
